\begin{example} \end{example}[The Euler Vector Field]

1. ch8:8.3The Euler vector field on $\mathbb {R}^n$ is \[ V_x=\sum _{i=1}^n x^i\left.\frac{\partial }{\partial x^i}\right|_x. \] It is smooth, vanishes at the origin, and points radially outward elsewhere. \end{example}
